newsitem.title: PERU: Peru credit to private sector up 15 pct first half.
newsitem.headline: Peru credit to private sector up 15 pct first half.

text.p: Credit from Peru's banking system to the private sector rose 4.417 billion soles, or 15.1 percent, to 33.731 billion soles during the first half of the year, the Central Reserve Bank said Monday.
Total credit from Peru's banks to the private sector in June rose 1.9 percent, compared with a total of 33.116 billion soles at the end of May.
Loans to the private sector in local currency stood at 8.430 billion soles at the end of June, while loans in foreign currencies stood at $9.548 billion.
In nominal terms, credit was up 47.8 percent last year from the 19.834 billion soles close of 1995.
